deferred_evidence.reason: The Sandero brochure contains a non-Eco-G performance column, but no exact matching active configuration is available for a source-safe projection.
The Stepway TCe 110 column is not imported because the reviewed master data contains no exact active Stepway TCe 110 configuration.
The automatic Stepway column states fourth-gear values only; blank fifth- and sixth-gear cells are not inferred.
The Jogger brochure states elasticity on fourth gear only; no fifth- or sixth-gear values are derived from transmission specifications.
LPG and petrol observations remain independent; a value stated for one fuel is never copied to the other fuel.
Values are assigned only to exact configurations supported by the source model, powertrain, transmission and passenger-layout evidence.

closure_decision: Close the selected-gear brochure performance import milestone with 70 exact observations, complete reporting preservation and all unstated or unmodeled evidence retained as explicit deferrals.
